text:
Jamie L: Hey team — first day setup question. Plugged into the CalDigit TS4 dock but macOS shows no Ethernet hardware. Wi‑Fi works fine but I need reliable wired for video calls. Anyone seen Broadcom USB NIC flakiness with the TS4?
Maria (IT): Hi Jamie! Welcome 🎉 Can you paste the output of `networksetup -listallhardwareports` and `ifconfig -a`? Also which Mac model / macOS version are you on?
Jamie L: MacBook Pro 14" M1 Pro, macOS 13.6.1
Jamie L: networksetup output:
```
Hardware Port: Wi-Fi
Device: en0
Ethernet Address: aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff

Hardware Port: USB 10/100/1000 LAN
Device: en3
Ethernet Address: 

Device en3: status: inactive
```
Jamie L: ifconfig en3 shows nothing, interface seems down.
Maria (IT): Hmm, seems the TS4's onboard Broadcom USB NIC isn't enumerating properly. Two quick things: 1) try unplugging the dock's power and plugging back in, 2) run `sudo pkill -HUP mDNSResponder` and replug the dock. If that doesn't help I'll escalate to network oncall. Can you also try a direct USB-C -> Ethernet dongle if you have one?
Jamie L: Did a power cycle and HUP, still nothing.
Maria (IT): Ok I'm opening an internal ticket TKT-2026 and ordering a spare USB-C -> RJ45 dongle to ship to you. cc @Carlos (Shipping) to dispatch today. I'll also schedule a quick remote session with @Sam (oncall-network) in case it's a firmware/compat issue.
it-bot: Ticket TKT-2026 created by Maria (IT) for Jamie L — category: hardware; priority: P2; ETA: 48h.
Carlos (Shipping): Got it, I can ship a dongle today UPS Ground. Shipping address on your onboarding form is 123 Market St — is that still correct?
Jamie L: Yes that's correct — thanks!
Sam (oncall-network): If the dongle arrives, please plug it in and run `networksetup -setdhcp en4` (where en4 is the new device) then `ifconfig en4` and paste results. I can jump on a quick Zoom if needed.
Carlos (Shipping): Shipped — UPS 1Z9999... ETA 2 days.
Jamie L: Dongle arrived, plugged in — interface shows up as en4 and I have DHCP lease, video calls stable now. Thanks everyone :raised_hands: 
Maria (IT): Awesome — marking TKT-2026 resolved. If you see recurring issues please reopen. Welcome aboard! :wave:
